channel.title: Somalia - The African Street Journal
channel.description: Daily news from Somalia, every source cited.

item.title: Fugitive Duqow saves 40 Somali soldiers
item.description: Duqow, a man sentenced to death, rescued soldiers lost after fighting Al-Shabaab in Lower Shabelle.

item.title: Somali army suffers heavy losses in Al-Shabaab ambush
item.description: Hundreds of soldiers feared dead or wounded after militants attacked advancing forces near Burhakabo.

item.title: AU troops to leave four bases in Somalia
item.description: Peacekeepers are pulling out of Lower Shabelle region due to financial strain, raising security concerns.
